long_description: Start from a real problem, discover the smallest truthful Evercraft capability, and identify its current public connection path when one exists. Evercraft preserves evidence and availability boundaries. Discovery does not grant private Systemia access, payment authority, publishing authority, deployment authority, or permission for other consequential actions.
release_notes: Evercraft v1.0.6 refreshes the ChatGPT/Codex release binding to the verified Evercraft-owned Fabric MCP after stale connector lifecycle drift. Discovery remains read-only and consequential actions retain separate authorization.
starter_prompts: I have a problem and do not know which Evercraft capability fits. Find the smallest useful option.
I have a video that's too large for this chat. What can handle it?
Find me a service for a discontinued machine part I cannot locate.
I want to evaluate whether my property is a good EV charging site.
My small-business website is slow and not converting. What can audit it?
I need sourced research on a land, water or resilience problem.
Our developer disappeared and our existing app is breaking. We need an evidence-first diagnosis before rebuilding.
remaining_platform_prerequisites: Select the existing Evercraft LLC public listing in the owning OpenAI Platform organization; do not create a second listing
Compare the current published v1.0.2 metadata, tools, domain and privacy / support URLs to the tested v1.0.6 package
Upload or select the canonical v1.0.6 update for that existing listing using the provider's supported update flow
Confirm the same owned Fabric MCP endpoint and verify the domain / scan results on that update
Review the five positive and three negative tests, documentation and walkthrough for v1.0.6
Complete any review / approval and explicitly publish the updated version if required by Platform
Record the actual public version, provider change receipt, and independent uninstalled-account search, installation and read-only invocation

match_evercraft_capability.readOnlyHint: True because the tool only scores and returns pre-published Evercraft capability metadata; it creates no records, jobs, payments, messages, or external side effects.
match_evercraft_capability.destructiveHint: False because the tool cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, send, purchase, publish, deploy, or otherwise mutate external state.
match_evercraft_capability.openWorldHint: False because the tool evaluates a bounded Evercraft capability catalog and does not browse, fetch arbitrary public internet resources, or operate on open-ended external entities.

list_evercraft_capabilities.readOnlyHint: True because the tool only lists pre-published public-safe capability metadata from the bounded Evercraft catalog.
list_evercraft_capabilities.destructiveHint: False because listing capabilities cannot modify or remove user, Evercraft, or third-party state.
list_evercraft_capabilities.openWorldHint: False because the tool reads a bounded Evercraft catalog rather than the public internet or arbitrary external entities.

get_evercraft_connection_options.readOnlyHint: True because the tool only returns pre-published connection metadata for one known capability and does not initiate the connection, authentication, payment, or work.
get_evercraft_connection_options.destructiveHint: False because the tool cannot change, delete, send, publish, purchase, deploy, or revoke anything.
get_evercraft_connection_options.openWorldHint: False because it looks up one capability inside the bounded Evercraft catalog; returned public URLs are metadata and are not fetched by the tool.
